descriptionInUI: Fixed-wing AI flights use Passive Defense unless a missile reports them as its target. Only the targeted flight receives Evade Fire. Missiles are followed until gone, including delayed targets and retargeting; failed controller orders are retried. Bounded command/error logs are always written to dcs.log; accepted orders do not guarantee a native evasive manoeuvre.

specificOptions.descriptionInUI: Add rate-limited on-screen diagnostics and debug lines. Command acceptance, failures and periodic tracking statistics are logged even when this is off.
